newsitem.title: PERU: Peru rebels say no solution without dialogue.
newsitem.headline: Peru rebels say no solution without dialogue.

text.p: Marxist rebels holding 74 VIP hostages at the Japanese ambassador's residence in Lima unfurled three banners early on Saturday in which they replied to an uncompromising speech by President Alberto Fujimori two days ago.
"Mr Fujimori, with arrogant declarations and without dialogue, there will never be a solution," one of the banners said.
The banners were placed by four rebels on the rooftop of the residence under cover of darkness at about 4.30 a.m. (0930 GMT), witnesses said.
The other banners read as follows:
"Mothers, wives and children of our prisoners are also waiting for their freedom. Peace for all Peruvians," and
"Today's Peru -- 13 million Peruvians in extreme poverty. Where is the progress?"
Fujimori on Thursday rejected the rebels' claim to be fighting poverty in Peru and accused them of "terrorism."
The hostage crisis entered its 18th day on Saturday.
